claude.result:
Perfect! All 324 tests pass. The customer merge functionality is now complete with 17 comprehensive tests:

**Added to `src/customers.js`:**
- **`mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)`** merges duplicate customers
  - Removes the fromId customer from the customers array
  - Updates all invoices with customerId === fromId to customerId === intoId
  - Returns `ok({ customers, invoices })` on success
  - Never mutates original arrays/objects
  - Normalizes both IDs before validation

**Error handling:**
- `SAME_CUSTOMER` - if fromId and intoId normalize to the same ID
- `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND` - if either customer doesn't exist

**Added to `src/errors.js`:**
- `SAME_CUSTOMER` error code

**Test coverage (17 new tests):**
- Removes fromId customer from array
- Keeps intoId customer in array
- Updates invoices from fromId to intoId
- Rejects same customer merge (various case/spacing combinations)
- Rejects if fromId not found
- Rejects if intoId not found
- Normalizes both IDs (case and whitespace)
- Does not mutate original customers array
- Does not mutate original invoices array
- Handles empty invoice array
- Case insensitive for same customer check
- Whitespace ignored for same customer check
- Returns reduced customer count
- Handles multiple invoices from same source
- Preserves all other invoice properties
- Handles mixed case in customer merge
- Does not affect unrelated invoices

All 324 tests pass (307 existing + 17 new merge customer tests).
